remarks: This cozy cottage is ready for you to move in. Hardwood flooring throughout. Your living room has a wood-burning fireplace and kitchen has stainless steel appliances. The spacious primary bedroom has a full bath and walk in closet. The other two bedrooms share a full bath. The bright, well-lit downstairs give you additional space to lounge--and a nice size backyard. Convenient location to public transportation with the Glenbrook train station a block away.
